1.consolidated_definition: Ir de compras. Pasar el rato mirando y comprando en distintas tiendas. Anglicismo híbrido, usual. Con los múltliples compromisos que requieren su vida universitaria y atlética, trata de llevar una vida normal. “Como cualquier joven, me encanta ir de shopping con mis amigas. Ir a la playa, ir a comer a los restaurantes, soy amante del Sushi” (Universiapr. com, 18-04-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To go shopping. To spend time browsing and purchasing at various stores. Hybrid Anglicism, commonly used.

As a university student with multiple commitments to her athletic life, she tries to lead a normal life. "Like any young person, I love going shopping with my friends. Going to the beach, eating out at restaurants, I'm a sushi lover" (Universiapr.com, 18-04-07)

Translation:
To go on a shopping spree. To spend time browsing and purchasing at various stores.
